title: The Prophet and the Question of Succession — Part 51

sentences.en: You will find sufficient information of this type in those books.

For example, Abu Huraira says: "The
clamor and violent rage of Hell will intensify, it will not calm down until Allah puts His leg in it.
It is enough for me; it is enough for me.'"

Abu Huraira also narrates that a group of people asked the
Holy Prophet, "Shall we see our Creator on the Day of Judgement?"

At mid-day
when the sky is free of clouds, does the Sun hurt you, if you look at it?"

Again he said: "During the nights when you see the full moon when the sky is clear,
does it hurt you?"

He continued: "So when you see Allah Almighty on the Day of
Judgement, you will not be hurt, just as you are not hurt by seeing these (the sun and the moon).

When the Day of Judgement comes, it will be announced by Allah that every community should follow
“its god”.

So, everyone who has worshiped idols, or, anything other than Allah, The One, shall be thrust
into Hell fire.

So, shall every one of the good and bad persons be thrown into it except those who worshipped Allah
(S.W.T.), the Absolute One.
